title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
reason: Concrete wallet security flaw with real losses and a developer patch is a publishable security story.

sources.summary: Attackers replaced legitimate transactions with fake ones, then waited for users to approve higher fees. At least one person lost bitcoin before developers patched the flaw.

title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips
reason: SpaceX raising $40 billion in debt for GPUs is a major, named AI-infrastructure funding event.

sources.summary: SpaceX has raised $40 billion in debt to buy GPUs, while Musk predicts a major shakeout among smaller AI cloud providers.
